title: The curse of language biases in remote sensing VQA: the role of spatial attributes, language diversity, and the need for clear evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model reliance on language priors and statistical shortcuts rather than visual grounding using a threefold strategy: 1) training 'visual blind' models (providing only the text question without the image), 2) adversarial testing (swapping or modifying the input images at inference to test visual reliance), and 3) dataset analysis (calculating the statistical distribution and imbalance of question-answer pairs to identify predictable priors).
